context:
Goal: the waiting page works with a keyboard and at any size.
Problem (rule): in the reply form at 520px or narrower, Send reply shows above Close, but Tab reaches Close first, so focus moves up the screen.
Based on (read): round 3 of #2347 (reviewer sonnet) found it; a test pins Send-first, and the design notes give no reason for it.
Departs from: main shows Send reply above Close on a narrow screen — Close would show first, matching the keyboard order.
Meanwhile: the lane keeps main's order and goes on.

options.how: On narrow screens Close shows above Send reply, so the screen order matches Tab order; the test that pins Send-first changes with it.
options.label: Close first
options.lose: Send reply is no longer on top.

options.label: Keep Send reply first
options.lose: Tab jumps focus up the screen.

ref: PR #2347 round 3 (reviewer sonnet); main's 520px-or-narrower rule in the waiting page
reply: Routed 13:11 CST Nov 9 to step notes-fix-page (lane session_013NEJKzjkypcToggneCjJN8, via the coordinator), roadmap 2e2d190de. On narrow screens Close shows above Send reply.
short: Reply form: Close first on phones?
title: On a narrow screen, should the reply form show Close above Send reply, so Tab moves down the screen?
